title: Implement Automatic HTTPS Redirect
description: This feature redirects users from HTTP to HTTPS, ensuring secure communication and protecting sensitive data. It will handle edge cases and provide clear logging for any errors. By implementing this feature, yantraverse will provide a more secure experience for its users.
testCases: Test redirect from HTTP to HTTPS
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all test cases pass, and the redirect works correctly for different scenarios. The redirect should handle common edge cases, such as query parameters and HTTP headers.
reason: Implementing automatic HTTPS redirect is a high-impact feature that improves the security of yantraverse, aligning with the framework's focus on security and production readiness.
